about: The admin brand colours the platform may choose (config admin.brand.color). One row per colour: brand = the base hue (tints), solid = the fill under white text, ink = the brand as text, border and focus ring in the light scheme. The dark scheme's ink is derived in CSS: color-mix(in oklab, brand 38%, #e6eeff). Values from the approved design table (docs/design-source/AUDIT.md, 9 colours x 20 roles, all WCAG AA). The first row is the default.
